tools.name: drives_search_vehicles
tools.description: Search the Pocket Drives marketplace for available rental vehicles by location, dates, category, and filters.

tools.name: drives_vehicle_detail
tools.description: Get full details for a specific vehicle including rates, host info, and organization policies.

tools.name: drives_vehicle_availability
tools.description: Get a monthly availability calendar with daily rates for a vehicle.

tools.name: drives_get_quote
tools.description: Calculate a full rental quote including daily breakdown, taxes, deposit, and total for a date range.

tools.name: drives_location_suggest
tools.description: Autocomplete cities, airports, and venues for search location input.

tools.name: drives_airport_search
tools.description: Search airports for delivery pickup with delivery fee information.

tools.name: drives_venue_search
tools.description: Search stadiums, arenas, and venues for delivery pickup with delivery fee information.

tools.name: drives_host_showroom
tools.description: Get a host profile page with bio, locations, team, and social links by username.

tools.name: drives_vehicle_reviews
tools.description: List published renter reviews for a vehicle. Uses asset_id (not asset_rental_id) per the GraphQL schema.
